description: What a valid CHARTER.md is, as data (#3481). The framework's charter helpers read their constants from here; cases[] is the conformance suite a downstream implementation of the placeholder rule and the shape rule runs to show it agrees. Version 2 (#3643) is the founding-only charter: seven required sections, no Current Focus, an Entity | Location Key Entities table, and no stored count or version (storedValues).

title.description: A generation requirement only: what /charter writes on line 1 of a new CHARTER.md, title.form with {name} as the project name, and what line 1 must match. It is not an input to the filled/unfilled decision: a charter is a template only by the placeholder rule, so a filled charter with any other title is filled (cases[] filled-charter-nonconforming-title). A consumer deciding whether a charter is filled must not test the title.

storedValues.description: What counts as a stored count or version (#3643). A charter changes only when what the project is for changes; a count or a version is derived from disk or read from the manifest that owns it, never stored here. Applied by the shape check and the legacy detection alike.

keyEntities.description: A Count column, or a cell that is only a number.

techStack.description: A version after a technology name (Electron 41, Tailwind CSS v4, Node.js 24.x) or a parenthesized quantity ((5 workflows)). Every cell of the table is read.

prose.description: A number followed by the noun it counts (58 commands, 17 specialist files). Not a year (a four-digit 19xx or 20xx: "Founded in 2024") and not an ordinal after a sequence word ("Phase 2", "Story 1.1"); a count shaped like a year is the accepted miss.

never.description: Never a count or a version: a digit inside a word (i18n, S3, OAuth2), an issue reference (#2209), a path, anything inside inline or fenced code, and anything in the Companion Repositories table (board ids). The patterns' boundaries encode the first three; code is removed by placeholder.codeExclusion first; the excluded sections are not read.

codeExclusion.fenceClose: A line whose leading run (after optional whitespace) is the opening fence's character, at least as long as the opening run, closes the fence. Every line from the opening fence to its close, both included, is removed. An unclosed fence removes the rest of the document.
codeExclusion.inlineCode: Outside fences, a run of N backticks, then text (possibly empty) containing no backtick, then N backticks, form one span, matched left to right; the span is removed. Spans never cross a line.

cases.description: Braces inside an inline code span are literal content: a path convention is not a placeholder. Praxis Hub Manager getCharterStatus strips no code and reads this as Pending.
